title: Composition of arbitrary supplied scalar arrow squares
statement: For three arbitrary coefficient ring objects R0,R1,R2, scalar maps a and b, three supplied diagrams and two ScalarCompatibility structures, define compositeSource to be the second derived functor applied to the first supported isomorphism, followed by the second supported isomorphism. Define compositeTarget to be the second derived functor applied to the first shifted line endpoint, followed by the second shifted endpoint. The parameter-bound compositeFunctor and compositeRestriction retain the coefficient choices of the supplied squares. compositeAdjunction composes the actual scalar adjunctions and collects their exact right functor by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The successive derived functor applied to the first diagram delta, followed by compositeTarget, equals compositeSource.hom followed by the third diagram delta.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Construct scalarAdjunction from the supplied derived extension/restriction adjunction. Compose the two actual adjunctions and use the exact mapDerivedCategoryCompIso to collect their right functor; no existence theorem or coefficient-object reconstruction is used.

Apply congrArg to the first supplied delta equation, mapping through the second derived scalar functor and postcomposing with the second shifted line endpoint. Expand map_comp, use the second supplied delta equation, and reassociate. The coefficient rings and line modules remain parameters throughout this proof.
